## Tastemakers Collective (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/)

TASTEMAKERSCOLLECTIVECatering and events in Los Angeles Custom menus for every event and every diet. Who we are A Los Angeles catering and events company. We cook modern California Italian food for offices, weddings, private parties, productions on set and music festivals. Our specialty is food for people with dietary restrictions, cooked from whole foods. Vegan, gluten free and dairy free options are on every menu, every dish is labeled, and halal is available on request. Our kitchen is led by a chef with seventeen years in fine dining kitchens and more than a decade cooking for artist hospitality and crews at music festivals. Services Catering Events Vending Weddings Custom menus and full service for your wedding day. We design the menu around you. ## About Tastemakers Collective (https://www.tastemakerscollective.us/about)

About About Tastemakers Collective Tastemakers Collective is a Los Angeles catering and events company. Custom menus for every event and every diet. What we do Catering Custom menus cooked and served at your event. Drop-off Boxed meals and pans delivered ready to serve. On set Crew breakfast and lunch delivered to location. Events Corporate events, private parties and celebrations. Festival vending Food vending, staff meals and artist hospitality. Bar service Bartenders and house-made mixers. You supply the alcohol. Pop-ups One-night events we run ourselves. Supper clubs Private dinners announced to our guest list. Who we are Tastemakers Collective is a chef-driven catering, events and food vending company in Los Angeles cooking modern California Italian food. Our specialty is food for people with dietary restrictions, cooked from whole foods. Our kitchen is led by a chef with seventeen years in fine dining kitchens in California and more than a decade cooking for artist hospitality, green rooms and crews at music festivals. We cook from a permitted commercial kitchen in Los Angeles. Credentials Permitted by LA County Public Health ServSafe certified manager $2M general liability insurance, certificate available on request Licensed California LLC Where we work Los Angeles and Southern California, plus festivals across California.
